race_courses.name: Powhite Park, 5 km
race_courses.start_note: Start and finish on the Powhite Park Loop Trail north of the Jahnke Road lot, about 185 m short of the loop. Each lap is the park's singletrack: the Powhite Park Loop Trail round the outside and the inner trails through the middle, on shared mountain-bike trails with some technical sections.

route_guide.getting_there: Park in the small lot off Jahnke Road at the south end of the park and walk north into the woods on the Powhite Park Loop Trail. The start line is on that trail, short of where it meets the loop.
